M14.note: Nominal dimensions from mixed references, not full GOST conformity. The source specifies H14 for D/t, a 0.5 x 45 degree seat/through-hole chamfer (clause 4), and GOST 11284 through holes (clause 6). This 2D symbol retains ISO 273 clearance and does not apply those tolerances or model the chamfer. The internal corner radius is limited to 0.3 mm by clause 4 and is not modelled. New M14 depth is 15 mm; existing drawings with the earlier 14.6 mm recommendation are unchanged.
